text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having made a name for herself back
home, Oguri Cap transfers to
the
acclaimed Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Word of her arrival travels quickly
between the trainers, and they
gather
around the campus training course to
watch her in action.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Whew...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for running with me, Oguri Cap.
Pffft, hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm? Why are you laughing?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my apologies, I did not intend to
offend. It has been a long while
since my
time has been spent so productively.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've heard many a tall tale about your
amazing feats racing in your
regional
course, but I only now realize just how true
they were.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You are second to none, Oguri Cap. I truly
look forward to competing
with you on the
turf.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I see. Then how about a race next time?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Impressive. So that is the renowned Oguri
Cap. It's not easy keeping
up with the
Emperor herself—and with such a cool
head too.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
And to so boldly challenge her to a race.
She must truly be confident
in her abilities.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, I must get going. There's a meet-up I
need to attend.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let's do this again sometime, Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: All right, then...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder where she's headed? Perhaps
she's going somewhere else to
train in
secret.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Could that be the key to her agility? If so,
I most certainly need to
watch this secret
practice of hers.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Are you also interested in seeing
Oguri's training? Why don't we
all go and
watch her together?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curious to figure out where Oguri Cap was
headed, I decide to stick
with the other
trainers and go after her.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Is she not going to start training?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
This is Oguri Cap we're talking about. I'm
sure there's some meaning
behind her
actions... or inaction, in this case.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: She's back! But why?!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: What a peculiar girl...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
What in the world is going on in that head
of hers? That's the fourth
time she's circled
around the same area...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Is this girl really second to none? I guess
we'll have to see... Let's
come back
another day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bewildered by Oguri Cap's perplexing
conduct, the trainers slowly
begin to take
their leave.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ummm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Worried about Oguri Cap's strange
behavior, I walk over to check on
her.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure. I keep walking and walking,
yet I end up at the same
place.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Does this academy really have four
identical locations?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Lost, you say... Perhaps so.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Who are you, anyway? I've never seen you
around these parts.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A trainer here... Could you show me where
to go?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying to get back to my dorm room. I
would appreciate the
assistance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give the lost Oguri directions back to her
dorm.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So that's where it is. Got it. Thanks for
your help. See ya.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few minutes after seeing off Oguri Cap,
she reappears from a
different direction.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I just saw a trainer who looks exactly
like you! Are you some
kinda
doppelganger?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...So it appears. Now that you mention it,
everything else is the same
too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's a challenge telling what's what in the
city. The buildings are all so
close
together, not to mention they look the
same. Things were much
simpler back
home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I knew my way around town. Turn right at
Tome's field, and you could
clearly see my
school. The bus stop was to the left of
Shige's large
warehouse. So easy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I passed by, Tome would give
me some mandarins to
munch on. They
were the absolute sweetest. Really takes
me back...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, I guess. But I can't go back just
yet.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tome, Shige, Chiyo, and Yoshi... They all
helped me get to
central—to race with the
best.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Everyone back home is cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I cannot—will not—let them down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap gazes on, finishing her little
speech with a fierce yet
forlorn expression
across her face.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm... It's about time I head back. The
dorm was this way, right? I'm
sure it's this
way...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Concerned that Oguri Cap would spend
the rest of the night
endlessly wandering
about the campus, I accompanied her back
to
her dorm entrance.
